observations: All eight reservoir overview pairs preserve lake, island and dam silhouettes in both profiles.
Close views at each group/profile maximum removed-face centroid change show the original base facets replacing small extra diagonal kinks; no new open seams are visible.
Steep Longmen and other near-water slopes remain in both versions and are not solved by this restoration.
limits: The views show production terrain and water, not complete buildings, streets, canopy, plinth, the dedicated sluice emitter or browser lighting.

This restores original base topology in zero-restoration cells. It is not a 5mm approximation to every point of the old dense mesh: maximum sampled removed-face centroid changes are3.632819m detail and5.578127m smooth.
The 5mm checks apply to source-base vertex sampling and seams. Retained native faces and source water/dam parameters are exact.
